driverNotes.note: Compliance dates differ by payer type: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid/CHIP fee-for-service by January 1, 2027; Medicaid and CHIP managed care by the rating period beginning on or after January 1, 2027; QHP issuers on the FFEs for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027. Parallel sections: Medicaid 42 CFR 431.60/.61/.70/.80, CHIP 457.730/.731/.732/.760, managed care 438.242 and 457.1233(d), QHP 45 CFR 156.221/.222/.223 (QHPs have no Provider Directory API duty).

The CFR still cites 45 CFR 170.215(b)(1)(i) (US Core 3.1.1) and (c)(1) (SMART 1.0.0), which expired in ONC's program on January 1, 2026. Newer versions are allowed under 42 CFR 422.119(c)(4) when the National Coordinator has approved them. CMS-0062-P (proposed April 14, 2026; not final as of this KB) would switch the cross-references to "unexpired" versions and require the Da Vinci and CARIN IGs at their 170.215 versions from October 1, 2027.

CMS's recommended IGs are not required: "the recommended IGs listed in table H3 are not required to be used at this time" (CMS FAQ). Its page still lists CRD/DTR/PAS 2.0.1 and 2.1.0, while provider EHRs certify (g)(31)–(33) to CRD 2.2.1, DTR 2.2.0 and PAS 2.2.1 since October 1, 2026.

Not FHIR packages but still required: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 for Patient Access, USCDI content (45 CFR 170.213), the HIPAA X12 278 transaction for prior authorization (CMS's National Standards Group will not enforce it against FHIR-based prior authorization, per its February 28, 2024 letter), specific denial reasons from January 1, 2026, and annual metrics reporting from 2026.
